_meta.description: Curated US purchase / ownership incentives for the Retail Ops pilot seed. Structured by hand from official sources because no open structured feed exists. Every record has valid_from/valid_to and status so the seed can model expired, active, and announced programs. Records marked verify=true must be re-checked against the source URL before a customer demo.
_meta.schema: incentive_id, tier (federal|state|utility|oem), scope, name, powertrains, amount_usd | amount_rule, eligibility, valid_from, valid_to, status (expired|active|announced), source_urls[], verify

incentives.name: New Clean Vehicle Credit (IRC 30D)
incentives.amount_rule: Up to $7,500 ($3,750 critical minerals + $3,750 battery components); point-of-sale transfer to dealer allowed from 2024
incentives.eligibility: MSRP cap $80,000 (SUV/van/pickup) or $55,000 (other); MAGI cap $300k joint / $225k HoH / $150k single; North American final assembly; eligible-vehicle list in us/irs_30d_list.csv
incentives.notes: Terminated by Public Law 119-21 (OBBBA) for vehicles acquired after 2025-09-30; binding contract + payment by that date still qualified. Seed uses it as the historical incentive on 2023-2025 outcomes and as an 'expired' example in A3 incentive panels.

incentives.name: Previously-Owned Clean Vehicle Credit (IRC 25E)
incentives.amount_rule: 30% of sale price up to $4,000; sale price <= $25,000; dealer sale; model year >= 2 years older

incentives.name: Qualified passenger vehicle loan interest deduction ('No Tax on Car Loan Interest')
incentives.amount_rule: Above-the-line deduction of up to $10,000 per year of interest paid on a loan for a NEW personal-use vehicle with final assembly in the United States; loan originated after 2024-12-31; available to itemizers and standard-deduction filers
incentives.eligibility: Phase-out for MAGI above $100,000 (single) / $200,000 (joint); new vehicle only (no used, no leases, no fleet); VIN reported on return; lender files Form 1098-VLI
incentives.notes: Replaces 30D as the main federal purchase lever. F&I Desk should surface estimated first-year interest and the deduction value in payment scenarios; A1 price_build should flag 'US final assembly' models. Final regulations published in the Federal Register 2026-09-08.

incentives.name: Colorado Innovative Motor Vehicle Credit
incentives.amount_rule: $3,500 for new EVs/PHEVs with MSRP <= $80,000 (tax year 2025; steps down in later years); +$2,500 for MSRP < $35,000; assignable to dealer at point of sale
incentives.eligibility: Colorado resident; new vehicle; MSRP cap

incentives.name: New York Drive Clean Rebate
incentives.amount_rule: Point-of-sale rebate up to $2,000 depending on electric range and MSRP (< $42,000 for max)
incentives.eligibility: New vehicle from participating NY dealer

incentives.name: Massachusetts MOR-EV
incentives.amount_rule: $3,500 for new BEV/FCEV with MSRP <= $55,000; +$1,500 income-qualified adder; used EV $3,500 (<= $40,000)

incentives.name: Illinois Electric Vehicle Rebate Program
incentives.amount_rule: $4,000 rebate for new or used all-electric vehicle purchased from an Illinois dealer; funding released in application rounds
incentives.eligibility: IL resident; apply within 90 days of purchase; income-prioritised

incentives.name: California Clean Vehicle Rebate Project (CVRP)
incentives.eligibility: Closed to new applications November 2023; successor programs are income-qualified (CC4A, Driving Clean Assistance)

incentives.name: Utility Level 2 home charger rebate (generic template)
incentives.amount_rule: $250-$1,000 rebate on a qualifying Level 2 charger and/or installation; many utilities also offer off-peak EV rates
incentives.eligibility: Residential customer of a participating utility; ENERGY STAR / networked charger
incentives.notes: Seed instantiates per-state examples (e.g., PG&E, ConEd, Xcel, Georgia Power) from the AFDC Laws & Incentives database; generic amount used when a state has no curated program.

incentives.name: Meridian Motors captive-finance APR special (synthetic)
incentives.amount_rule: 0.9% APR 36 mo / 2.9% APR 60 mo on select models, OR $1,500 customer cash; EV models: additional $2,000 'charge-ahead' cash + complimentary Level 2 charger install
incentives.eligibility: Well-qualified buyers through captive finance; not combinable with employee pricing
incentives.notes: Synthetic OEM program modelled on typical US OEM monthly specials; amounts are fictional.
